title: I Built an INSANELY Profitable AI Trading Bot for FREE (Full Guide)
description:
👉🏻 Learn AI trading bots and algorithmic trading with us:
https://www.skool.com/daviddtech/about

Impressive equity curves are easy to share. This video shows you how to build the system behind them.

I built an AI trading desk with Hermes Agent that can research trading ideas, develop strategies, backtest them, and organize the results in a custom Mission Control dashboard.

In this full guide, I take you through the setup step by step: installing Hermes, connecting an AI model, adding the TradingKit backtesting tools, building your agent team, and creating your own control panel.

Then I show you how to take the resulting Pine Script into TradingView, check the backtest, and connect strategy alerts to a broker through Trigger.trade.

But finding an impressive backtest is only part of the process.

After more than five years of building and testing automated trading systems, I’ve tested over 2,000 strategies and currently trade seven. At the end, I explain what that experience has taught me about selecting strategies and deciding what deserves further testing.

## In this video, you’ll discover:

✅ How to install Hermes Agent and complete the initial setup
✅ How I connect my existing ChatGPT subscription and select GPT-6 Astra
✅ How to set up Telegram and use the Hermes desktop interface
✅ How to connect TradingKit’s backtesting tools through an MCP server
✅ How to run an initial BTCUSDT strategy backtest
✅ How to build an AI trading research team with reusable prompts
✅ How I structure agents and schedules to reduce unnecessary token use
✅ How to create a Mission Control dashboard and connect your agents to it
✅ How to export Pine Script and verify strategy results in TradingView
✅ How to connect TradingView alerts and webhooks to Trigger.trade
✅ Why forward testing matters before committing money to a strategy
✅ What five years of automated trading have taught me

## ⏰ Video Chapters

0:00 – The Hermes Trading Bot and Backtest Results
0:43 – What We’re Building
